purpose: Canonical retrieval contract for the 12 textured Celine v80 room source GLBs.

library_backup.role: secondary immutable backup and independent provenance source

important_path_semantics: The primary worker-accessible source is the pinned GitHub LFS commit/path above. The files are on the sibling branch assets/celine-source-persistence, not automatically on the active v80 implementation branch.
Git metadata contains small LFS pointer files; the pointer oid sha256 and size identify the original GLB bytes. A worker that needs the bytes must use Git LFS-aware checkout/fetch/materialization.
The Library root remains a valid backup path, but a worker does not need Library access when the pinned GitHub LFS source is accessible and passes all canonical hash checks.
Never treat either source location as permission to mutate the original GLB bytes in place.
pre_assembly_gate: Read root AGENTS.md, live queue, active work order/amendment, validation policy, room README, execution trunk, this retrieval contract and ROOM_SOURCE_GITHUB_LFS_BRIDGE.json.
Prefer the pinned GitHub LFS source when available; otherwise materialize the Library backup through an authorized Files/Library capability.
Verify exactly 12 unique GLB filenames are present.

Verify every original GLB identity against expected_sources and SOURCE_SHA256SUMS.txt. For GitHub LFS, verify pointer oid sha256 and size before fetching/processing bytes; for materialized bytes, verify SHA-256 directly.
Preserve original source bytes unchanged; work only on derived/materialized/workspace copies.
Nachttisch.glb may be instantiated twice in the final room but must remain one source binary.
Do not retrieve, restore or substitute the superseded six untextured GLBs.
hard_stop_conditions: Neither the pinned GitHub LFS source nor the Library backup can be accessed/materialized.
Any of the 12 expected files is missing.
Any filename is unexpected or ambiguous.
Any SHA-256/LFS oid differs from the canonical value.
Any Git LFS pointer size differs from the canonical source byte size.
The worker can see only stale/untextured room sources.
hard_stop_action: Do not build a substitute room, do not use stale GLBs, do not guess paths and do not continue source-derived room work. Record the source-access or identity mismatch as the blocker and restore access to one canonical source channel first.
relationship_rule: ROOM_SOURCE_GITHUB_LFS_BRIDGE.json is the durable map from the immutable raw originals to the accepted optimized modular room parts, assembly/world/anchor/nav contracts and canonical Celine separation rules.
runtime_rule: Raw source GLBs are preservation inputs, not APK-ready assets. Optimize derived copies and build/use the bounded modular production room; never copy all raw 120-189 MB GLBs directly into the APK.
viewer_rule: Tischfürlaptop.glb is the physical foreground table. The laptop itself is the camera/viewer and must not be visible in the final room.
